t: Hambarek haek yitnaheg bekos shel birkat hammazon
s: Hambarek haek yitnaheg bekos shel birkat hammazon, ubo t"v seipim: asara debarim neemru bekos shel beraka: taun hadacha, ushetipa, chay, umale, ittur, veittup, meqabbelo bishte yadayv, venoteno limino, umagbiho tepach, venoten enayv bo. Veyesh omerim ap meshaggero bemattana derek doron vachashibut leanshe beto, zo ishto, vaapillu lo okla immahem, kede lehaniach beraka lebeto:

"Hadacha ushetipa" — hadacha mibbipnim, ushetipa mibbachutz, kede sheyyehe kos shel beraka yapeh mibbayit umichutz. Veim hu naqi mibbayit umibbachutz, veen bo shiyyure kosot, dehaynu shiyyure yayin sheshshara bo pat, o sheqqinnecho yapeh bemappa — dayyo, kevan shehu yapeh mibbayit umibbachutz:

"Chay" — yesh omerim sheyyitten mehayyayin chay letok hakkos, ukeshemmaggia lebirkat haaretz — yitten letoko mayim, shekkol kos shel beraka mitzva min hammubchar sheyyehe mazug, kede sheyyehe areb. Velamma bebirkat haaretz? Lehodia shebach haaretz, sheyyenoteha chazaqim utzerikim meziga. Veap al pi shehambarek bechutz laaretz, meachar sheeno mozeg ad birkat haaretz — mukach haddabar sheshshebach eretz yisrael hu ba leharot. Mikkol maqom, im en hayyayin chazaq, shehu areb belo meziga — en tzarik lemozgo kelal. Ubiqtzat meqomot nohagin limzog kol yayin al pi haqqabbala:

Veyesh meporshim "chay" bilshon ashkenaz peri"sh, sheyyotziennu mehechabit miyyad samuk labberaka. Ubimdinot ellu sheen lanu yayin harbeh — en tzarik ella leshopko mehaqqanqan shemmachaziqin bo yayin samuk labberaka, velo mehechabit, ella im ken sholeach lachenvani liqnot, azay yishlach samuk labberaka, sheyyihyeh chay mehechabit. Veyesh meporshim "chay", sheyyehe hakkos shalem, sheshshebirat hakkelim zo hi mitatan. Vaapillu nishbar basis shel matta — pasul, ella im ken bishat haddechaq. Vetob lachosh lekol happerushim kesheepshar. "Male" — kemashmao, sheyyehe male al kol gedotayv. Umikkol maqom, im choshesh sheim yehe male harbeh yishpok veyitbazzeh umanniach qetzat reqan lemala — en lachosh, sheadayin shem male alayv:

"Ittur" — yesh mi shehaya meatterehu betalmidim, shehaya moshib talmidayv sebibotayv bishat habberaka. Veyesh mi shehaya meatterehu bekosot, shehaya manniach kosot yapim sebibayv lehaddero bahem. Veanu en lanu "ittur":

"Ittup" — yesh mi shehaya mitattep betallito. Veyesh mi shehaya pores sudaro al rosho. Veanu en lanu "ittup". Umikkol maqom, kol yere shamayim lo yebarek bemitznepet, raq yasim hakkoba al rosho. Veyesh medaqdeqin nohagin gam ken lehitattep babbeged haelyon. Veyesh omerim al pi haqqabbala sheen "ittup" ella beeretz yisrael, mippene kebod hashshekina:

"Meqabbelo bishte yadayv" — leharot chabibut hakkos, shehu chosheq leqabbelo bekol kocho. Ukesheyyatchil lebarek — notelo bimino lebaddo velo bishte yadayv, kede shello yehe nireh kemassaoy alayv, vehayyamin hi chashuba yoter likbod hakkos, velo yesayyea kelal bismol apillu lismok bah yemino, sheen hassemol nogaat bakkos kelal. Veyesh mattirim litmok hayyamin bismol. Veyesh lehachamir, im lo letzorek, kegon shehakkos gadol. Veim hambarek itter — ochez hakkos beyamin shello, shehu semol kol adam, shehi chashuba etzlo. Veen littol hakkos bebatte yadayim, raq yesirem qodem. Veyesh mi sheomer sheal pi haqqabbala yesh lehaamid hakkos al hakkap, vehaetzbaot tihyena zequpot sebib hakkos, velo leechoz beetzbeotayv. Veyesh omerim lehaamid al haetzbaot mammash:
Magbiho min haqqarqa tepach — im hu yosheb al gabbe qarqa. Veim hu meseb bashshulchan — magbiho meal hashshulchan tepach, kede sheyyehe nireh lekol hamsubbin veyistakkelu bo:

Venoten enayv bo — kede shello yassiach dato mimmennu. Veal ken yesh mi shepposel kos sheppiv tzar (sheqqorin qelu"g gela"z) lebarek alayv, mippene sheeno yakol litten enayv bayyayin shebbetoko. Veen zeh nakon, shello hitzriku litten enayv bayyayin ella bakkos, shello yassiach dato mimmennu. Umikkol maqom, lekattechilla yesh lebarek al kos acher (kede sheyyukal lishtot rebiit keachat, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman q"tz, mah shei epshar laasot ken beqal bekos sheppiv tzar). Abal im en sham kos acher beqallut — yebarek al zeh, veen bo chashash pesul kelal:

Mishsheyyochaz hakkos beyado lebarek — lo yasiach hambarek apillu sicha qalla b' veg' tebot, mishshum hessach haddaat. Veyesh omerim sheggam hamsubbin en lahem lehasiach mishshennatal hambarek hakkos beyado lebarek. Vetob lachosh ledibrehem lekattechilla. Uledibre hakkol, mishshehitchil hambarek lebarek — lo yasichu gam hamsubbin. En tzarik lomar beshaa shehu mebarek, shehem tzerikim lishmoa ulehabin mah sheomer hambarek, ella apillu ben beraka libraka — en lahem lehasiach, kemo sheen hambarek rashshay lehasiach, shehashshomea kimbarek beatzmo. Veim aberu vesachu ben beraka libraka beshaa shehambarek shoteq meat — yatzeu. Vaapillu im sach hambarek beatzmo — yatza. Abal im sachu beshaa shehu mebarek — lo yatzeu. Veshaaruriyya zo metzuya ben hehamon, shebbeshaa shehambarek bezimmun mebarek — en shomein lo, umedabberim debarim acherim, veoberim al aseh shel tora bishat nepesh. Vetob meod haya shello lebarek kelal bezimmun, sheaz haya kol echad mebarek leatzmo, mah sheen ken akshav, shettoim lomar sheyyotzeim bebirkat hambarek, vehem enam shomein mah hu omer. Vegam lekol adam nakon sheyyomar belachash milla bemilla im hambarek kol beraka uberaka, vaapillu hachatimot, lepi sheen kol adam yakol lekavven lishmoa kol teba veteba mippi hambarek, veim beemtza yipneh lebabo velo yishma ezo teba hamakkebet — lo yetze yede chobato. Ubachatimot yemaher lesayyem qodem sheyyesayyem hambarek, kede sheyyukal laanot "amen" acharayv, kemo shennitbaer besiman n"a vn"t. Veap al pi sheen mezammenin ella keshemmitztorpin lebarek kullam birkat hammazon bebat achat, dehaynu sheechad mebarek lekullam, velo keshekkol echad mebarek leatzmo, sheen kan zimmun kelal, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qtz"g, mikkol maqom, kevan shekkol birkat hammazon ad hachatima omerim kullam yachad milla bemilla im hambarek birkat hammazon — hare zeh kaamira achat, vegam hachatimot hem chozerim veshomeim mippi hambarek veonim "amen" acharayv, kemo kesheechad mebarek lekullam mammash. Veap al pi shebbirkat hazzimmun tzerikim lishmoa mippi hambarek davqa, kemo sheyyitbaer sham, mikkol maqom, bebirkat hammazon mechamat chesron kavvana — yesh linhog ken. Veyesh choleqin al zeh veomerim, sheen mezammenim ella im ken echad mebarek lekullam vehem shomeim, ulekol happachot tzerikim lishtoq velishmoa ad siyyum birkat "hazzan". Veken iqqar. Umissiyyum birkat "hazzan" vaelak yesh linhog kassebara harishona mechamat dochaq chesron kavvana, abal ad siyyum birkat "hazzan" hashshemia meakkebet hazzimmun, sheen yotzeim yede zimmun kelal baaniyyat "baruk sheakalnu" lebad, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qtz"g:

Yesh mi sheomer shelleinyan lishol bebirkat hammazon mippene hayyira o mippene hakkabod dinah kitpilla, sheen mapsiqin bah ella mippene chashash sakkana, velo kiqriat shema ubirkoteha sheheqelu bahen mippene hayyira vehakkabod. (Lepi shebbiqriat shema neemar: "vedibbarta bam", vedareshu chakamim: mikkan sheyyesh leka reshut ledabber bam debarim acherim, veen tzarik liqrotah kullah bitkipa achat min hattora, ella middibre soperim, vehem ameru lehaqel mippene hayyira vehakkabod, velo rau lehachamir bebirkat qeriat shema sheiqqaran middibre soperim yoter mibbiqriat shema atzmah. Abal birkat hammazon tzarik lihyot lekattechilla bitkipa achat min hattora, shekken hu mashmaut happasuq: "uberakta et Hashem eloheka al haaretz hattoba asher natan lak", lebarek al haaretz vehammazon virushalayim bibraka achat belo hepseq benetayim, ella en zeh meakkeb bediabad, hoil velo neemar bebirkat hammazon "yihyu" — bahavayatan yihyu, kemo shenneemar biqriat shema leinyan qeraah lemaprea, kemo shennitbaer besiman s"d):

Tzarik lesheb beshaa shemmebarek, ben im haya mehallek bebeto kesheakal, ben sheakalo meummad o (meseb), keshemmaggia lebarek — tzarik lesheb, kede sheyyukal lekavven yoter, velo yehe meseb, shehu derek gaava, ella yesheb beema. Velo hambarek bilbad, ella kol hamsubbin lo yeshebu beqallut rosh, ella beema. Ak im lo asu ken, apillu berak mehallek — bediabad yatza. Vekol zeh bebeto, abal hamhallek badderek veokel derek hilluko — en tzarik lesheb ulebarek, lepi sheen dato meyushshebet alayv im yesheb, mippene sheyyiqsheh beenayv ichur darko, velo yukal lekavven yapeh:

Lo hechemiru lebarek meyushshab ella bebirkat hammazon, hoil vehi min hattora. Veyesh omerim shehu haddin libraka achat meen g' ap al pi shehi middibre soperim, hoil vehi meen g' shel tora. Veyesh lachosh ledibrehem:

Asur laasot melaka beodo mebarek, mippene shennireh kimbarek bederek aray umiqreh. Apillu tashmish qal asur laasot, ap al pi sheeno moneo millekavven. Veen tzarik lomar shello yaasoq bedabar shetztzarik lasum libbo elayv, vaapillu hi debar mitzva, kegon eseq hattora, shennimtza poneh lebabo mikkavvanot habberaka. Vezeh eno nakon lekattechilla gam bishar berakot, shekkevan shekkullam tzerikim kavvana lekattechilla ledibre hakkol. Veken biqriat shema apillu mippereq sheni vaelak, mah sheen ken melaka bayyadayim lo maneu ella bepereq a' shel qeriat shema:
En notenim kos shel beraka lebarek ella letob ayin, shehu sone betza vegomel chesed bemamono, shenneemar "tob ayin hu yeborak", al tiqra "yeborak" ella "yebarek":
